artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows several figures gathered around an infant in a makeshift crib. The scene includes people kneeling or standing around the infant, some looking down at the child. The central figure holding the infant has delicate facial features and is centrally positioned. The individuals have varied hairstyles, mostly long or shoulder-length and wavy. They are dressed in flowing robes and wraps. One person is holding a lamb. Cherubs hover above the scene with wings spread wide. The setting is a rustic structure or stable with a partially thatched roof and support beams. In the background, hilly landscapes with trees are visible.

artworks.title: Artus Quellinus the Elder
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 31.5 × 22.5 cm (12 3/8 × 8 7/8 in.)
sheet: 31.7 × 22.5 cm (12 1/2 × 8 7/8 in.), trimmed to platemark
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper half. He is positioned slightly turned to his right with his head facing forward. The man has a mature face with a mustache and shoulder-length wavy hair. He is dressed in a period-appropriate garment with a high collar and lace cravat. One hand is on his chest, and the other hand is visible at the bottom of the frame. The portrait is within an oval frame decorated with a leaf garland. The background has a fine texture, and below the portrait is a script inscription with the name "Artus Quellinius" and additional text.

artworks.title: Flock of Sheep Resting
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a group of sheep resting on the ground. The perspective is slightly elevated. The landscape slopes downward, with some structures partially visible in the distance on the right side. The engraving style uses fine lines to create texture in the wool of the sheep and the stone surface. The color palette is monochromatic, in black and gray tones. Closest to the viewer, there is a detailed cluster of sheep. In the background, there are rocks, foliage, and trees, with hints of a hillside or path leading towards the less distinct horizon.

artworks.title: Ballerina
artworks.medium: monotype printed in blue-green and yellow-green on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image portrays a person in motion, seemingly a dancer. The individual is in a dynamic stance, suggesting movement. The face and hair details are blurred in the impressionistic style with sweeping brush strokes. The person is wearing a flowing dress typical of a dancer's costume, depicted through textured strokes. There are no visible accessories or objects held. The background is abstract and textured, with horizontal and swirling strokes creating depth and motion around the figure.

artworks.title: A Rustic House with a Tottering Wood Fence
artworks.artist: Joseph Constantine Stadler, after Joseph Farington
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching printed in brown with aquatint printed in blue and brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with an old timber-framed house in the center, surrounded by rolling hills, clusters of trees, and a dirt path. A horse, figure, and wooden fence are on the right side. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing the texture of the architecture. The color palette includes muted earth tones and soft grays against a lightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Louis XVI, Marie-Antoinette, and the Dauphin
artworks.artist: French 18th Century, after Augustin de Saint-Aubin, after Piat Joseph Sauvage
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Rena M. Hoisington in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows a circular medallion with side-profile busts of three figures engraved in a detailed style. They are positioned one behind the other, facing right. The first figure has long hair, the second has shorter curls, and the third has delicate features. The medallion is mounted on a plinth with decorative foliage and an urn on top. Engraved script below the medallion suggests a commemorative purpose. The background includes patterns and a minimalist depiction of clouds.

artworks.title: Mythological Roundels
artworks.artist: Jean-Philippe-Guy le Gentil, Comte de Paroy
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological or classical figures and creatures arranged in a grid of circles. The circles feature various scenes and figures, such as winged beings, human-animal hybrids, and graceful figures in motion. The drawing style is meticulous and detailed, capturing the poses and expressions with clarity. Each circle encloses a unique scene, depicting narratives of ancient times. The background is plain, allowing the detailed engravings within the circles to stand as focal points. The grid structure provides a coherent layout while emphasizing the individual elements within each section.

artworks.title: Mythological Roundels
artworks.artist: Jean-Philippe-Guy le Gentil, Comte de Paroy
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a grid of circular illustrations featuring mythological and dynamic figures. Each cell contains a separate circular black background with a white or light-colored figure depicted in delicate detail. The figures are engaged in various actions like playing instruments, combat, or athletic activities, riding creatures, or carrying weapons and shields, suggesting themes of mythology, ancient stories, and fantasy. The arrangement in rows and columns provides a sense of order and symmetry, while each circle contains a unique scene adding diversity to the overall composition.

artworks.title: The Bearing of the Cross
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Fontana, after Domenico Campagnola
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 40.6 × 65.3 cm (16 × 25 11/16 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large group of people gathered around a rocky landscape with a city in the background. The scene is densely populated with figures engaged in various activities, predominantly centered around the action of several figures carrying a large wooden cross up a hill, accompanied by armed guards on foot and horseback. The landscape is detailed with rocky formations and a few trees scattered throughout. There are many small groups of figures, some of whom are gathered around what appears to be an open tomb in the foreground. In the background, a cityscape is visible with various buildings and spires silhouetted against a clouded sky. The complexity of the drawing consists of intricate line work and detailed characterization of each figure, presenting a vivid narrative scene.

artworks.title: Studies of Character Heads
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund

artworks.title: Nieuwjaar (New Year)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in black on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nancy Jane and Alan Shestack
artworks.description: This is a drawing of peacocks in a natural setting. The drawing includes several peacocks, with one displaying its tail feathers. The feathers have eye patterns typical of peacocks, with detailed cross-hatching for texture. In the foreground, other peacocks are surrounded by a decorative border. The black and white contrast emphasizes the intricate details of the feathers and the ornate elements of the scene.

artworks.title: Kerstnacht (Christmas Eve)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in black on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nancy Jane and Alan Shestack
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two owls resting in an abstract natural landscape. The drawing shows two owls nestled together surrounded by natural forms resembling ice or stalagmites against a stylized sky. Above them, a group of birds fly in formation across the night sky, accompanied by faint cloud formations and a distant single star. The use of monochrome and intricate line work gives the piece a mystical and ethereal quality.

artworks.title: Peter with a Gunshot Wound in His Forehead
artworks.medium: drypoint printed in black on Japan paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in
memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of a person's face, focusing on the upper portion from forehead to lips. The individual faces forward with eyes wide open, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and partially opened lips. The person's hair is loosely indicated above the forehead. The sketch is done in a cross-hatched style with visible pencil or charcoal-like strokes. The person is not adorned with clothing, jewelry, or accessories. The background is plain and light-colored, emphasizing the facial features.

artworks.title: Faust and the Ditchdigging Workers
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a gathering of people near a waterfront with a prominent tower structure. The drawing features a group of figures situated on a sloped terrain. One figure, positioned prominently in the foreground, appears to be leaning with a walking cane or stick. In the background, the outline of a large body of water is visible, suggestive of a river or sea, with a detailed architectural structure that resembles a series of buildings or a tower resting at the water's edge. The sketch is executed with a focus on lines and shadings, providing a contrast between the figures and the environment, capturing a moment of interaction and atmospheric perspective.

artworks.title: Study for 'Les cinq peintres' (The Five Painters)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Anonymous
artworks.description: The image features five figures depicted from the knees up in a group setting. The central figure is a seated man with a long beard and tousled hair, surrounded by four other individuals. One man is standing and facing him, while another is reaching out his arm. A third figure is seated to the left of the central man, and a fourth stands behind the group. The sketch lacks detailed facial features, and the clothing is simple without intricate patterns. The background is plain, and the sketch is enclosed in a loose rectangular border.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jak Katalan in honor of Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a person's head and shoulders in a three-quarter view, facing slightly right. The facial features are detailed with soft lines, showcasing a prominent nose and mustache. The person has long, wavy hair flowing around the neck. The focus is on the face and hair, with no clothing or accessories depicted. The background is plain with a visible paper texture, and a light brown spot is present on the upper part of the sheet.

artworks.title: Vevey
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows a gently sloping riverbank extending into the distance, with a low horizon and a light, open sky merging with the distant landscape where water meets land. On the right, a row of trees with dark green foliage lines the riverbank. The painting features loose brushstrokes capturing textures of foliage and ground, creating a serene, impressionistic feel. The earth tones are muted with patches of darkness for shadow, and the color palette includes browns, greens, and hints of blue in the water.

artworks.title: Statuette of a Buddha
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows a painting of a golden statue. The statue is positioned centrally and slightly oriented towards the right side. It sits atop a pedestal or platform with a subtle pinkish hue below it. The color palette consists of soft earthy tones such as gold, brown, and beige, with accents of pink, red, and pale greens creating a harmoniously muted backdrop. The statue is placed slightly to the right of center within the composition, with the background gradually fading into a lighter tone towards the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Quayside Scene with Church
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene. A building is on the left side, with soft brushstrokes. The horizon, shoreline, and sailboats are visible. The sailboats have long masts against the sky and water. The watercolor technique creates a serene atmosphere. The color palette includes soft blues, warm browns, and muted greens. The sky blends with the water, creating a peaceful visual.

artworks.title: Church and Street, Camprodon
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with buildings viewed from a town square. A large, light-toned building with a red-tile roof and distinctive round window is on the right side of the composition. Long shadows suggest late afternoon. The brushstrokes are subtle, creating a realistic, slightly textured appearance. Warm earthy tones are used for the buildings, contrasting with the blue sky and greenery. A hill is visible in the distance.

artworks.title: A Loggia
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The painting shows a covered walkway with arches that recede into the distance. The horizon is not visible and the scene is framed by the perspective of the corridor. The artist uses loose brushstrokes to depict light and shadow along the walls and floor. The color palette is soft and muted, with cool grays, blues, and beige tones, contrasted by warm earthy hues of figures in the distance. Light filters through the arches, casting long shadows and creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Street, Tunis
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene featuring the architectural details of a building. The perspective is from below along a sloping street, emphasizing height and depth. A row of vertical columns supports a roof overhang in the foreground, leading towards the right side of the image. On the right, a tall tower transitions into a brightly colored roof with intricate brick and stone work. The painting shows detailed brushwork, creating a realistic and textured portrayal of the architecture. The color scheme consists of earthy tones such as pale yellows, browns, and grays, with touches of green and red, offering a warm and rustic visual appeal.

artworks.title: Building with Washing
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a path or road leading towards a large building by a waterway. The low horizon is obscured by buildings, with a sky filled with soft pastel hues. The buildings on the right have colorful facades and there are clothes hanging on a line outside. In the distance to the left, there is a low bridge spanning across the water to another building. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, especially in the water. The color palette includes earthy browns, rusty reds, soft pinks, and pale blues.

artworks.title: Cordoba
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows a street viewed from an eye-level perspective. The horizon is not visible, but the convergence of buildings further along the street creates depth. The brushstrokes are fluid and painterly, typical of watercolor techniques, with soft blending and layers portraying light and shadow delicately. The color palette is warm, dominated by yellows, ochres, and beiges of the buildings, contrasted by the bright blue sky. The street scene lacks details close to us, focusing on architectural forms and the interplay of light and shadow on the surfaces of the walls.
